camel_example: aliyun sas AddPrivateRegistry --region cn-hangzhou --UserName xxxxx --RegistryType harbor --DomainName 'example.com' --ProtocolType 2 --RegistryHostIp '114.55.**.**' --NetType 2 --RegistryVersion V2 --Password '******' --RegistryRegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
description_en: Connects to a self-managed image registry
kebab_example: aliyun sas add-private-registry --registry-type harbor --registry-version V2 --protocol-type 2 --net-type 2 --registry-host-ip '114.55.**.**' --domain-name example.com --user-name xxxxx --password '******' --registry-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddPrivateRegistry
